options.name: access_token
options.description: The access token used to authenticate.

options.name: annotations
options.description: Annotations to allow client tools to store small amount of arbitrary data. This is distinct from labels. https://google.aip.dev/128 An object containing a list of "key": value pairs. Example: { "name": "wrench", "mass": "1.3kg", "count": "3" }. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the annotations present in your configuration.

options.name: backup_id
options.description: The ID of the alloydb backup. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: cluster_name
options.description: The full resource name of the backup source cluster (e.g., projects/{project}/locations/{location}/clusters/{clusterId}). This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: display_name
options.description: User-settable and human-readable display name for the Backup.

options.name: encryption_config
options.description: EncryptionConfig describes the encryption config of a cluster or a backup that is encrypted with a CMEK (customer-managed encryption key).

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: labels
options.description: User-defined labels for the alloydb backup. An object containing a list of "key": value pairs. Example: { "name": "wrench", "mass": "1.3kg", "count": "3" }. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.

options.name: location
options.description: The location where the alloydb backup should reside. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used.

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should exist in GCP.

options.name: type
options.description: The backup type, which suggests the trigger for the backup.
